basic_info.description: Discover the perfect blend of classic charm and modern sophistication at this wonderful designer family compound in the heart of Noe Valley. Built on a prominent corner lot that nestles on the coveted Sanchez St. hill, the homes were crafted by two sisters with an impeccable eye for design and lifestyle. Every detail, from the curated Farrow & Ball walls to the Thomasville Artisan Line kitchens with Honed Carrara Marble and Casearstone london gray honed quartz, makes these homes exquisite. The spaces feature lighting by Visual Comfort, Rejuvenation, and hardware by Strom Living and Kingston Brass. They share easy access to the sunlit gardens. Delivered vacant, each home has in-unit laundry, new bathrooms, and kitchens. Everything in the compound was chosen to evoke a sense of warmth, elegance, and timeless living.
